mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic output, which increases corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with positive INDPRO change, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve's tightening policy compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 3.0%, it signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening residential construction, which signals economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with positive HOUST change, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 135,000 persons, it indicates a strong labor market and rising consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS > 135000.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an expansionary supply regime (INDPRO growth rate > 0.5% monthly), strengthening industrial output supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with INDPRO growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
